title: Hermès Resale Report — November 2026

metadata.universe: Covered listing IDs; not authenticated unique physical bags or the entire market
metadata.currencies: Stored USD asking prices; auction native currencies and price bases kept separate
metadata.inventory_clock: Current state at acquisition; no historical reconstruction
metadata.method: Available listing IDs with finite positive USD asking prices; exclude all-nines placeholder prices and accessories, and identify special variants/HSS separately using the October normalization rules. Medians and quartiles describe covered listings. Counts are not unique authenticated physical bags.
metadata.caveats: Asking prices are not completed sales. Condition, age, colour, leather, hardware and dealer mix are not fully adjusted; coverage changes are not market growth. Stored USD conversions may reflect different FX dates. Streams are not an atomic snapshot; current availability cannot be reconstructed from this extraction.
metadata.evidence: source_manifest.json and tables.json in the acquisition directory

stats.label: median same-listing asking change in 90 days

cohort_gate: n>=10 and >=3 merchant slugs; valid-priced active standard handbag IDs
publication: Public snapshot of the Hermès Resale Report, November 2026 (https://birkinbagstock.com/reports/hermes-resale-november-2026). Asking prices, not sales.
